answer: Sybils can be slowed by giving each established agent only a few vouching slots, like a quill that holds only so much pigment: to create a new trusted identity, an existing agent must spend one slot and stake its own reputation on the newcomer. A nebula of thousands of fake accounts cannot appear, because there are not enough vouches to cover them, and bad vouches burn the voucher's standing. Over time, unused or abused identities fade, so maintaining many fakes costs constant attention, while one honest agent needs only one slot.
